tube.definition: Organ with organ cavity which connects the cavity of the middle ear to the cavity of the pharynx. Examples: There are only two pharyngotympanic tubes, the right and the left pharyngotympanic tubes.[FMA].

cavity.definition: Small cavity surrounding the bones of the middle ear.
